title: CryptoRefund
tagline: Offering an incentivized form of shopping with tax-free benefit that can be paid back in crypto
description:
For mass adoption, we are offering a tax-free shopping experience in crypto.
Everybody likes to be refunded after having a shopping and we're making it easily accessible in crypto.

In order to be protected by the fraud, we have already a moving pieces to cover the requirement of a mediator, so we can only focus on additional feature of identity verification. We thought that we can utilize Polygon ID to ensure only necessary information is being shared with the platform and the beneficiary. Another reason of why we have preferred Polygon ID is to deploy quickly on Polygon chain too
how_its_made:
We are a big fan of Austin Griffith's tutorials on Youtube. At first, we have tried to utilize the Scaffold-ETH as a base for our project however, it turns out to be a not good fit. It was requiring a good amount of development and with our team, it wouldn't be possible given Hackathon constrains. Therefore, we abandoned the project after we forked and do some kind of proof of concept testing under our new Github organization: Cr8Product

We built our application by using the Next.JS framework. The smart contract development is done by the Hardhat and it is deployed into zkEVM testnet, Linea testnet, Mantle.
Business logic is heavily written by the Javascript
